claims.subject: BrightSpring indebtedness

claims.claim_text: PharMerica settled a long-running False Claims Act / Anti-Kickback qui tam matter (Relator Silver, D.N.J.) for an estimated $115.0 million in Nov 2023, without admitting liability, subject to DOJ and court approval.
claims.subject: PharMerica False Claims Act settlement
claims.source_quote: On November 18, 2023, the Company agreed to settle the matter without admitting liability. ... The estimated financial impact of the settlement is $115.0 million
